title: Private parts of a public document
about: An ACL applies to the node it is put on and everything beneath it; nested ACLs need both secrets, and something made from a private node is only as visible as that node.

steps.xml: <summary>public, but made from the private note</summary>

checks.name: without a key only the public part shows
x shows the private parts and what was made from them
nested ACLs need both keys: y alone shows nothing private
shredding the private note takes what was made from it
